intro: Nizam College and Siddhartha Degree College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded BCA fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Nizam College vs Siddhartha Degree College is not a single winner. Nizam College is recorded as a public institute, while Siddhartha Degree College is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Nizam College vs Siddhartha Degree College for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nizam College if you want a public BCA option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Siddhartha Degree College if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹13,500 a year as tuition fees for Nizam College's Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹25,000 a year as tuition fees for Siddhartha Degree College's Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Nizam College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹4 lakh for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, Siddhartha Degree College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Nizam College on this BCA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Siddhartha Degree College on this BCA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Nizam College is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Siddhartha Degree College can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
